name: design-toolkit
description: Design review tooling for UI work. Founding skill: design-spec, which makes the review material for a UI change: a quick card (one composed image) or a full sheet (a claude.ai Artifact republished each round), built from a state inventory checked against the server contract and captured headless at fixed viewports, 2x, in light and dark. ui-inspect measures the screen first: overflow, clipped or covered text, contrast, font faults, and icon alignment, at the same viewports and themes. design-audit lists what is generic or broken on an existing screen, in the order to fix it. clean-copy cuts interface copy that should not exist and shapes what survives, error messages included. design-system-sync republishes a repo's Design System library after a merge that touched its declared source paths, prompted by a hook on gh pr merge. site-taste gives marketing pages an art direction, vendored from taste-skill v2: a dealt direction, a measured house style, and a screenshot critique loop. design-system-doc writes a repo's DESIGN.md from its real tokens, each value cited to file:line and each gap an open question.
